initial_failure: Normal and deep approval completions unconditionally cleared a newer pending plan; both new HTTP cases failed.
fix: Carry the durable approval request identity in PlanState and retire only the matching approved plan in cache and database. Await conditional retirement; a database outage leaves the durable approved claim intact.

cases: new approval of same plan preserved

compatibility.scope: Chat persistence, Telegram interactive delivery and deep-plan routing

ratchet: Completion helper extraction reduced run_approved below the oversized-function threshold; removed its obsolete exception rather than increasing any cap.
checks: Ruff lint/format and diff checks pass.
limits: The competing-new-plan case is verified through mocked-runner HTTP tests and actual private SQL separately. Canonical browser cases verify ordinary retirement and original-request recovery. Revision/rejection write races and death between approval claim and native admission remain open; no production deployment or full acceptance claim.
